headline: Former Chhatra Dal leader detained for beating police officer in Magura
summary: Naimuzzaman, a former president of the local Chhatra Dal, was taken into custody following a viral video showing the assault.
details: A former president of the Magura Thana Chhatra Dal, Naimuzzaman, has been detained by police.
The arrest follows the circulation of a viral video showing a police officer being beaten.
Authorities took action after the footage of the assault became public and sparked concern.
The detained individual is now under investigation as police process the case regarding the attack on the law enforcement official.

headline_marked: Mirpur: [[Jamaat and BNP supporters clash]] over funeral wash room construction
headline: Mirpur: Jamaat and BNP supporters clash over funeral wash room construction
summary: Hundreds of activists from both parties clashed in the Pallabi Bihari Camp on Saturday, with reports of blank cartridges being fired.
details: A violent clash broke out between supporters of Jamaat-e-Islami and the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) in the Pallabi Bihari Camp of Mirpur, Dhaka.
The conflict centered around the construction of a room for washing deceased bodies in Block 11 of the camp.
According to police and local sources, the incident occurred on Saturday afternoon after 4 PM in front of the Talab Camp.
The clash involved approximately 50-60 Jamaat activists led by Manik and 200-300 BNP and Bihari organization supporters led by Sohel and Sadaqat Khan Fakkur.
Police reported that several rounds of blank cartridges were fired and cocktails were thrown during the chaos.
Authorities stated that the situation in the camp area has since returned to normal.
Additional police personnel have been deployed to the site to prevent any further unpleasant incidents.
caption:
Blank cartridges and cocktails thrown as hundreds clash in Mirpur's Bihari Camp.

A violent clash broke out between supporters of Jamaat-e-Islami and the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) in the Pallabi Bihari Camp of Mirpur, Dhaka.

The conflict centered around the construction of a room for washing deceased bodies in Block 11 of the camp.

According to police and local sources, the incident occurred on Saturday afternoon after 4 PM in front of the Talab Camp.

The clash involved approximately 50-60 Jamaat activists led by Manik and 200-300 BNP and Bihari organization supporters led by Sohel and Sadaqat Khan Fakkur.

Police reported that several rounds of blank cartridges were fired and cocktails were thrown during the chaos.

Authorities stated that the situation in the camp area has since returned to normal.

Additional police personnel have been deployed to the site to prevent any further unpleasant incidents.

#Dhaka #Mirpur #PoliticalClash #BangladeshNews #BNP #Jamaat

Source: Jamuna TV
